model_provider.value: Kimchi Coding offers MiniMax M3; AI Enabler documents OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic, and self-hosted Llama 3.1 via vLLM as supported options.
model_provider.notes: The newsroom explicitly says MiniMax M3 is available through Kimchi Coding: https://cast.ai/newsroom. The supported-provider documentation names OpenAI, Anthropic and hosted_vllm, with GPT-4o and Llama 3.1 examples: https://docs.cast.ai/docs/ai-supported-providers. These are supported options, not a claim that every customer uses every provider.
